data.name: Fatan
data.gender_notes: Fatan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman with a slender and agile build. Derived from the Arabic root 'fat' which means to be slender or agile. The name Fatan carries the meaning “Slender, Agile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fatan usually hope their child will grow to embody slender, agile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents grace, agility, and quickness in movement and thought.
data.etymology: Fatan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Slender, Agile.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: فتان

in_english.name: Fatan
in_english.meaning: Attractive and charming, handsome and renowned
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fatan is derived from the Arabic root 'fitna', which means to test or tempt. In Islamic tradition, fitna refers to a divine trial or examination. Fatan is a name given to a person who captivates their family and surroundings with their personality and behavior, making them stand out and hold a special place in their lives. The name signifies someone who is charming, attractive, and well-known for their good qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Fatan" carries a deep cultural significance in the Arab world as it is often associated with beauty, grace, and agility. In Arabic literature and folklore, "Fatarah" (plural of "Fatan") are described as being embodiments of feminine beauty and charm. The name continues to be popular among Arabic speakers due to its association with desirable qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the name "Fatan" can also carry a spiritual significance. It represents the idea of refinement and purification, as one who is slender or agile can be seen as having a delicate and precious nature. The name can be a reminder of the importance of being spiritually agile and able to adapt to all experiences in life. It also reflects the idea of inner and outer beauty, as emphasized in Islamic teachings. Ultimately, the name "Fatan" can serve as a source of inspiration for those seeking to cultivate both the outer and inner aspects of their being.
